name: slack-bridge
description: Single-plugin marketplace for slack-bridge: bind a local Claude Code session to a Slack channel or owner DM (build-in-public bridge).

plugins.name: slack-bridge
plugins.description: 把本地 Claude Code session 与一个 Slack 会话(频道或 owner DM)一一绑定的 build-in-public 桥:频道内 @bot 的消息投递进 session,每轮最终输出自动转发回去;owner 消息直投,其他成员消息由 owner 点按钮审批。
